THE ECHO OF A REVOLUTION

The monarchy fell.
The questions remained.

Who holds power? Who gets a voice? What does equality really mean? The revolution did not settle these questions. It made them impossible to ignore.

01 /

Liberty

Freedom from arbitrary rule became a powerful ideal. Yet revolutionary governments also imprisoned and executed their opponents.

02 /

Equality

Inherited privileges were challenged. But women lacked equal political rights, and colonial slavery exposed the limits of universal promises.

03 /

Popular sovereignty

Authority could come from the nation rather than a royal bloodline. Napoleon’s rise showed how fragile that principle could be.
